english.title: Landlord carry out repairs to premises while final letting notice in force
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the landlord of premises at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) in relation to which you had been served with a final letting notice, without reasonable excuse

(A)_[carried out]_
(B)_[permitted the carrying out of]_

works to the premises whilst the notice was in force without the written consent of the local authority that had served it
english.legislation: Contrary to section 200(1) and (5) of the Levelling Up and Regeneration Act 2023.
